question: For item lines belonging to 2025 orders, join to the food dimension and classify each line as Veg, Non-Veg, or Unknown (null or unmatched food ID). Report for each group: (1) item-line count, (2) total ordered units, (3) share of total ordered units computed as group ordered units divided by the sum of ordered units across all three groups times 100. State the total ordered units used as the denominator.

action.query:
WITH line_classification AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN f.FOOD_ID IS NULL OR f.VEG_OR_NON_VEG IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
            WHEN UPPER(TRIM(f.VEG_OR_NON_VEG)) = 'VEG' THEN 'Veg'
            WHEN UPPER(REPLACE(TRIM(f.VEG_OR_NON_VEG), '-', ' ')) IN ('NON VEG', 'NONVEG') THEN 'Non-Veg'
            ELSE 'Unknown'
        END AS food_group,
        i.QUANTITY
    FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER_ITEM i
    JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER o
      ON o.ORDER_ID = i.ORDER_ID
    LEFT JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.DIM_FOOD f
      ON f.FOOD_ID = i.FOOD_ID
    WHERE o.ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01'
      AND o.ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
), grouped AS (
    SELECT food_group, COUNT(*) AS item_line_count, SUM(QUANTITY) AS ordered_units
    FROM line_classification
    GROUP BY food_group
), categories AS (
    SELECT column1 AS food_group
    FROM VALUES ('Veg'), ('Non-Veg'), ('Unknown')
), totals AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ordered_units), 0) AS total_ordered_units
    FROM grouped
)
SELECT
    c.food_group,
    COALESCE(g.item_line_count, 0) AS item_line_count,
    COALESCE(g.ordered_units, 0) AS ordered_units,
    t.total_ordered_units,
    100.0 * COALESCE(g.ordered_units, 0) / NULLIF(t.total_ordered_units, 0) AS ordered_units_share_percent
FROM categories c
LEFT JOIN grouped g ON g.food_group = c.food_group
CROSS JOIN totals t
ORDER BY CASE c.food_group WHEN 'Veg' THEN 1 WHEN 'Non-Veg' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END

action.answer:
For item lines on orders with recorded ORDER_DATE in 2025, food-group totals are:

| Group | Item-line count | Ordered units | Share of ordered units |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Veg | 7,277,939 | 8,877,759 | 72.584811% |
| Non-Veg | 2,749,222 | 3,353,105 | 27.415082% |
| Unknown (null or unmatched food ID) | 12 | 13 | 0.000106% |

The share denominator is **12,230,877 total ordered units** across all three groups. Shares are group ordered units divided by this denominator, multiplied by 100.
